title: The Lily Pads
text: Lily pads as big as rafts cover a grey lake, edge to edge, from shore to shore. On each one sits a frog the size of a hound, throat pulsing, eyes like brass coins. They watch you. Every so often one of them snaps at a passing heron, and swallows it whole.

options.label: Hop across on the pads, and hope the frogs are not hungry.

outcomes.text: The frogs watch with brass eyes, and let you.
The frogs do not let you, and they are very quick.

options.label: The kindest tosses them bread, to buy their good mood.

outcomes.text: They croak, deep and pleased, and make a path.

options.label: Go round the lake, and leave the frogs to their herons.

outcomes.text: A long, wet way, and the frogs watch the whole time.
